$Comment: One of Old Jack's four dailies: bring the Headless Horseman down on his normal ride once a day.
The _Hallows_Eve folder makes the id hallows_eve_jack_daily_horseman. Requires opens it once a
player has finished The Rider (hallows_eve_old_jack_horseman) and collected its pay, so it
follows a first win over him. Old Jack offers it on his daily_offer screen beside the other
three, and while it is carried his conversation opens on his rider line, horseman, which says
where the Gravekeeper stands and that his gate wants a Grave Candle from the stall.
ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED names his fight's script, never a creature, so it holds through his change of
form. MatchMode EXACT on the normal ride's script keeps a win on the hard ride
(Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Encounter_Hard) from counting; MatchMode PREFIX would let either
ride count, as the Horseman_Down achievement does. Every player the fight credits counts the win,
but only those carrying this quest when he falls. The step reuses The Rider's wording.
Npc.TurnInId, which the Parent sets, adds the report-back step to Old Jack, so it is handed in to
Repeat.Reset with Period Daily is a calendar daily: it comes back at midnight UTC, not a fixed
number of hours after the last one. Each daily pays through Hallows_Eve_Daily_Pay, so retuning
that pay is one edit there; the favor rows are this file's own, and Amount is how much.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the fight, paid only where that mod runs. Its
own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without it, unpaid and
unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Jack_Daily_Horseman
